svg.text: claudia creates — layouts and templates: editing and managing layouts (E10.4, reworked)
Mock round of 22 Nov 2026, for review. Content is invented. A layout opens as a slide and is edited like one: placeholders and other objects (a logo, a footer line, the page number).
All layouts… parallels All styles…; deleting a layout moves its slides and frees the objects that took its placeholders.
H · Edit this layout…: the layout opens as a slide
Same canvas, same tools and the same undo as for a slide. What sits on the layout shows on every slide that follows it.
12 slides follow it. Changes apply to all of them.
Layout “Two lists” · what is for: compare two things
Dashed frames are placeholders: they show purpose, style and a hint text while
editing, and nothing in the show. Objects without a dashed frame (logo, footer,
number) belong to the layout and appear on every slide that follows it.
I · All layouts…: browse and manage, as All styles…
Two panes as in D302: the list on the left, the chosen layout on the right.
Only the 1 waiting for a name
Other objects on it: logo, footer text, number
Built-in layouts can be hidden only.
J · Deleting a layout that slides follow
Delete… asks where the slides go. It is the same rule as changing a slide’s layout in the picker, and the preview of sheet 2 shows what moves.
12 slides follow it. Move them to:
Objects that took a placeholder with the same purpose label follow it in the new layout.
The others become free boxes at their present frame, so no text is lost.
Here: “Title” goes to “Title”. “Left list” and “Right list” become free boxes on 12 slides.
• A built-in layout cannot be deleted; the dialog offers Hide instead.
• Deleting a layout is one step; Undo brings the layout and the slides back.
• The same matching by purpose label is used when a slide changes layout in
the picker, and when a deck changes template.
• A purpose label is the name inside a layout; two layouts both having “Title”
is what lets a slide’s title survive a change of layout.
• Placeholders that nothing took are simply gone with the layout.
